caller_asset_contract.notes: Every source, MATLAB, LTFAT and CVX path, experiment config, licence, rights record, reference experiment, cohort manifest, parity vector and output-use grant must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 or revision before a caller may process audio. No upstream revision is pinned because the merged evidence records only project and repository URLs; a shape-valid manifest cannot manufacture qualification.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the exact declipping2020_codes source checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision under data/checkouts/declipping2020_codes or a recorded alias; no checkout exists in the workspace.
Resolve https://github.com/rajmic/declipping2020_codes to a full 40-hex commit and publish its per-file SHA-256 manifest; the merged evidence records only the project and repository URLs.

Provide one licensed MATLAB installation plus LTFAT and CVX at exact revisions with a recorded platform and environment manifest at data/envs/matlab-ltfat-cvx/environment.json; MATLAB is proprietary and none of MATLAB, LTFAT or CVX is present.

Pin the exact C-OMP experiment: dictionary/frame, window and hop, block length, clipping threshold and exact mask policy, sparsity or target cardinality, stopping tolerance, iteration cap, regularization and expected numeric output. The merged research document reports only that the authors' toolbox needs MATLAB, LTFAT and CVX and was not runnable in the Python pilot.

Record the exact sample rate, channels, block/frame length, hop, dictionary, boundary/padding rule, content delay and output interval mapping in a pinned config; the merged evidence contains no C-OMP geometry.

Add the declipping2020_codes licence and terms at the resolved commit, the MATLAB licence basis, and LTFAT/CVX licence terms at their exact revisions; no licence file, terms statement, redistribution grant or product-use review is recorded.

Clear source-audio, clean-reference, training/evaluation and output-use rights, then freeze a rights-cleared paired clipped/clean speech cohort with thresholds, exact masks and occupancy strata; only source-reported sibling pilot material exists and it contains no C-OMP row.

Produce one approved exact-runtime C-OMP output, a frozen parity vector, task-specific quality and peak/timing evidence, and any authorized listening result; no local output, parity vector, benchmark or timing result exists.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex source/toolbox revisions, MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX identity, experiment config and metadata SHA-256 values and the source licence match exact pins.
An isolated, licensed MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX runtime with a complete environment manifest is admitted on a recorded platform.
Source, MATLAB, LTFAT, CVX, source-audio, clean-reference, output-use and redistribution rights are cleared with notices.
An approved exact-runtime C-OMP output matches the documented reference experiment on a frozen caller-supplied input and config.
A rights-cleared held-out cohort stratifies clipping threshold, occupancy and bandwidth and scores task-specific quality, peaks and preservation as separate outcomes.
Input/output rates, block length, dictionary, padding, content delay and validity intervals are established and the candidate is not misrepresented as a streaming SDK processor.
Explicit opt-in processor intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete; the component remains optional.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

qualification.reason: The exact declipping2020_codes source checkout, full upstream revision, MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX runtime, documented C-OMP experiment, task geometry and hash-pinned environment are absent; no licence, rights record, rights-cleared clipped/clean cohort, clean reference, parity vector or local C-OMP output exists.

restoration_profile_requirements.requirement: Freeze the hard-clipping threshold, exact mask, sample rate, channels, block length and corresponding clean/audio baseline.
Include the clipped-input identity and an established task-matched sparse or POCS baseline.
Stratify results by clipping occupancy, threshold, bandwidth and content type rather than pooling one condition.
Report validity, nonfinite failure and exact output/mask intervals.
Score SI-SDR, RMSE, STOI or authorized listening against permitted clean references.
Bound output peaks, duration and content/availability timing.
Record missing, invalid, nonfinite and adverse control results.

cvx.role: convex solver dependency used by C-OMP

matlab.role: proprietary MATLAB runtime for the authors' toolbox

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the restoration acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates.
stable_fields.deliverable: Retain or reproduce the comparison as an optional SDK developer/evidence adapter alongside audio-bench, with a documented proceed/defer decision before exposing it as a processor. Resolve MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX availability, or reproduce only the documented reference experiment.
stable_fields.title: C-OMP declipping
write_scope: SDK provider, tool or evidence directory for c-omp-declipping and its own fixtures
